measured.basis: Each constant is 1.25 x the largest value measured over every overlapped generated-schedule run on the validated_for hosts (three early-completion and two late-completion runs), rounded up to 1 MiB, so the envelope's own margin is 1.0: the prepare charge (generation_peak_bytes + 8 MiB + compile_peak_bytes, compile_peak_bytes 0) covers the prepare from the start of generation to the end of the compile (at most 242.6 MiB); load_peak_bytes.all covers the load and warm-up, early (over the footprint just before the load) or late (from the eviction until the load that finished after it released its model), at most 854.9 MiB; the resident part (runtime_weight_bytes + 2 x I/O + workspace_bytes, runtime_weight_bytes being weight.bin's size) covers the steady state over the footprint just before the load, at most 854.0 MiB, which holds the memory the warm-up prediction allocates for the program's GPU and CPU segments; ane_compile_reserve_bytes covers ANECompilerService's largest absolute size while loading (190.8 MiB), since no run found the service clean (it held 67-106 MiB before every load) and a service that already holds memory reuses it, so its growth (at most 97.6 MiB) understates a cold compile on a clean host
